name: Pokéfeet
storyline:
Every morning, Professor Willow’s eccentric cousin (Dr. Solea, the world‑famous Poké‑Podiatrist) sends you a new batch of mysterious Pokémon footprints discovered across the region.
According to her, something strange is happening: Pokémon have started leaving unusually distinctive footprints, almost as if they want to be found.

Your mission is simple:
Identify each footprint, help Dr. Solea fill her Footprint Pokédex, and uncover why these tracks are appearing in such curious patterns.
summary:
web-based trivia game where you'll have to guess a Pokémon by its feet (and some advices revealed in case you're needing a hint).
Challenges – Daily or Weekly: Put yourself to the test using our selection of 5 to 10 Pokémon per game. Emoji Share System to compare your results with your friends, Marathon Mode, Feet-dex
